test_set.description: Everyday questions for a general voice assistant.

test_cases.input_str: Ask for a quick dinner idea using chicken and rice, then ask how long it takes.
expected_behaviors: Suggests a dish that uses chicken and rice
Gives a cooking time when asked

test_cases.input_str: Ask how many days are left until the end of the year, then thank the assistant and hang up.
expected_behaviors: Answers or explains how to work it out

personas.name: Corral easy caller
personas.persona_prompt: You are calling a voice assistant. Speak clearly, answer its questions, and stay on task.

personas.name: Corral hard caller
personas.persona_prompt: You are calling a voice assistant while busy. Talk quickly, change your mind once, and cut in when it rambles.

metrics.description: Did the assistant give the caller what they asked for?
metrics.prompt: Did the assistant answer every request the caller made, accurately and without making things up?

metrics.description: Average time from the caller's last word to the agent's first audio, from Corral's own spans.
